component.name: mikuterm
component.summary: Terminal whose tabs are SSH connections

description.p: mikuterm (Micro Unicode Terminal) is the terminal of zedBSD with its own SSH client built in: each tab is an SSH connection to a host of its ssh_config, or one typed as user@host:port.

ul.li: Tabs, each an SSH connection with its own thread
Ed25519 keys, known_hosts, port forwarding and RemoteCommand
A settings tab that makes keys and checks the hosts' settings
Colour emoji, wide and ambiguous-width characters, and a fallback font
